patterns.title: Variable Window
patterns.description: Grow until valid or invalid, then shrink to restore the target condition.
patterns.explanation: Variable windows are ideal when a contiguous segment changes one element at a time.

problems.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters

notes.intuition: Maintain a window that never contains duplicate characters.
notes.whyPattern: The right pointer expands candidates and the left pointer removes conflicts.
mistakes: Updating answer while the window is invalid

problems.approach: Track character counts or last seen positions and move left until duplicates disappear.
